records.title: XRPL LendingProtocol amendment voting status
records.summary: At ledger 108,009,471 the LendingProtocol (XLS-66) amendment is in Voting status with 19 of 35 trusted validators (54.3%) supporting it; 29 votes (>80%) held for 14 days are required. ripple.com appears among supporting validators.
records.limitations: Independent node/dashboard observation; status can change with later validations. This is not an official XRPL Foundation announcement.

records.title: XRPL native lending amendment and activation dashboard
records.summary: The dashboard states that XLS-66 native lending is in validator voting and that the LendingProtocol and SingleAssetVault amendments must both activate before native lending goes live. Its page at the captured time did not report activation.
records.limitations: Dashboard is a secondary observer; amendment status should be cross-checked against live validator votes and the official amendment mechanism.

records.title: Official amendment activation mechanism
records.summary: Official XRPL documentation explains that an amendment activates automatically after more than 80% of trusted validators vote in favor continuously for two weeks; if support falls below the threshold before then, the timer resets.
records.limitations: Protocol documentation describes the rule, not the current live vote count. Current status must be obtained from ledger-backed amendment trackers.
